sentences.text: Sinohelicoprion is an extinct genus of eugeneodontid fish known as the "Chinese spiral saw".
H. T. Liu and M. N. Chang first named and classified the genus in 1963.
The animal is classified in the class Chondrichthyes, which includes cartilaginous fish like sharks and rays.
It belongs to the parent group Helicampodontidae.
Sinohelicoprion is classified within the family Helicampodontidae.
Fossil evidence places the animal's time range strictly within the Changhsingian stage, from 254.14 to 251.902 million years ago.
